plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to reduce broad index concentration and free up capital.
Add to QQQI to increase focus on income generation.
Trim CRWD and SMH to further reduce concentration in tech and semis.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage and concentration.
Expect lower volatility and a more conservative growth profile.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, leading to lower expected drawdowns. However, upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF exposure to acceptable levels.
Trim SPY to lower broad index concentration.
Trim CRWD and SMH to reduce concentration in tech and semiconductors.
Buy HOOD, a strong scanner setup, to add a new growth opportunity.
This plan balances risk reduction with selective growth opportunities.
Expect moderate growth with controlled risk and drawdowns.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. It seeks risk-first growth, aiming for moderate gains with controlled drawdowns. Leverage remains present but managed.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL to increase exposure to leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to reduce broad index concentration.
Trim CRWD and SMH to reduce concentration in tech and semiconductors.
Buy HOOD, a strong scanner setup, to add a new growth opportunity.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and leverage decay.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentrating on high-potential names. It accepts significantly higher risk, including larger drawdowns and the impact of leveraged ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

moves.note: Reduce broad index for income focus

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to reduce broad index exposure.
Trim CRWD and SMH to reduce exposure to high-beta single names.
Add to QQQI to maximize focus on income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
Expect low drawdowns and consistent, though variable, income distributions.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing capital preservation. It minimizes leverage and high-beta single names, focusing on income-generating ETFs. While aiming for low drawdowns, NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
